entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Alok Singh, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 15 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Sawayajpur,
District Hardoi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 28.01.2023 against six persons, including the applicant, alleging that the applicant purchased the informant's property through a sale deed executed by some imposter projecting himself to be the informant.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
It has further been Yaduveer Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Yaduveer Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174896013/
1 stated that the informant has already filed a civil suit for cancellation of sale deed bearing Civil Suit No.209 of 2023 before the Court of learned Civil Judge, Junior Division, Hardoi, which is pending consideration.
5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the dispute between the parties is predominantly of civil nature, regarding which a civil suit is already pending, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since21.06.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
